events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair, a pivotal moment in music history, took place from August 15-18, 1969, on a dairy farm in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Woodstock Vibe
angles.copy: 57 years since Woodstock! Which legendary performance from the festival's line-up still gives you goosebumps?

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 91
events.blurb: On this day, we remember the passing of the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 91.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, today. His music defined generations and continues to inspire. What's your all-time favourite Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur would have been 55
events.blurb: On this day, we reflect on the life and legacy of influential rapper Tupac Shakur, who was tragically shot in Las Vegas and would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur today. His powerful lyrics and undeniable impact continue to resonate. Which of his tracks means the most to you?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix would have been 84
events.blurb: We mark the anniversary of the passing of electric guitar pioneer Jimi Hendrix, who would have been 84.

angles.name: Jimi's Enduring Sound
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Jimi Hendrix today. His revolutionary guitar playing changed music forever. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic album 'Abbey Road' on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Abbey Road At 57
angles.copy: It's 57 years since The Beatles dropped 'Abbey Road'. That album cover is still one of the most famous of all time. What's your favourite track from it?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Happy birthday to The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the iconic Chrissie Hynde! What's your favourite Pretenders anthem?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy birthday to the unmistakable voice of Oasis, Liam Gallagher, who turns 54 today.

angles.name: Our Kid's Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis track or solo hit from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released as a single in the US on October 11, 1971, and in the UK on October 24, 1975.

angles.name: Imagine's Message
angles.copy: 55 years since John Lennon's 'Imagine' was released. Its message of peace and unity is as powerful today as it ever was. What does this song mean to you?

events.title: The Original iPod's Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the revolutionary first-generation iPod on this day in 2001, changing how we listen to music forever.

angles.name: iPod Nostalgia
angles.copy: Remember the first iPod? 25 years ago, Apple launched the device that put '1,000 songs in your pocket'. Did you have one of the originals?

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: October 5th marks James Bond Day, celebrating the iconic British spy film series.

angles.name: Bond, James Bond
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember the legendary John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday. His music and message continue to inspire millions. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy birthday to the comedy legend and Monty Python star, John Cleese, who turns 87 today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Monty Python to Fawlty Towers, what's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their groundbreaking double album, officially titled 'The Beatles' but widely known as 'The White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: White Album's Impact
angles.copy: It's 58 years since The Beatles unveiled 'The White Album'. A sprawling masterpiece, but what's your go-to track from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury would have been 80
events.blurb: On this day, we pay tribute to the incomparable Queen frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie
angles.copy: Remembering the legendary Freddie Mercury today. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched. What's your favourite Queen song featuring Freddie?

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' influential album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Reflections
angles.copy: 59 years since The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul'. Often cited as a pivotal album, what's your standout track from it?
